summary: Atomic tenant-scoped usage ingestion returns the stored winner under competing retries.
Normalized same-payload retries return the original identity; changed-payload retries return HTTP 409 without mutation.
A tenant-scoped GET route makes POST Location readable.
Response-start middleware and Problem Details customization preserve matching request correlation identifiers on errors.
Nine detailed learning documents explain real source, concepts, worked changes, tests, debugging, exercises, solution reasoning and request traces.

checks.environment: .NET SDK 10.0.302; isolated copy; locked restore; local memory adapters and ASP.NET test host

limits: Default usage storage remains in memory and is not coordinated across processes.
Route tenancy is not production authentication/authorization.
Subscription existence/ownership is a documented extension, not implemented in this use case.
No live database, browser, provider or deployed environment verified.
